description: Source code implementing event handling functions for Samsung's OpenMAX IL (OMX) layer, including creation, termination, reset, set, and wait operations for thread synchronization events.

methods.name: SEC_OSAL_SignalCreate
methods.description: Creates and initializes a thread event object, including mutex and condition variable.

methods.name: SEC_OSAL_SignalTerminate
methods.description: Destroys the event object, releasing resources.

methods.name: SEC_OSAL_SignalReset
methods.description: Resets the event signal to false.

methods.name: SEC_OSAL_SignalSet
methods.description: Sets the event signal to true and signals waiting threads.

methods.name: SEC_OSAL_SignalWait
methods.description: Waits for the event signal to be set, with optional timeout.
